name: United States
prevalence_note: FTC, FBI IC3 & SSA OIG 2025-2026: Medicare card/equipment scams, IRS/SSA arrest-warrant calls, gold-bar & cash courier government imposter fraud, fake missed-jury-duty warrants, Amazon/Geek Squad AnyDesk/TeamViewer + Zelle scams, Spanish IRS/Seguro Social extortion, and unpaid toll texts/calls lead losses.
cross_border_note: Offshore scam call centers routinely spoof +1 local US area codes ('neighbor spoofing') as well as official IRS, SSA, Medicare, federal court, sheriff, and major bank caller IDs through international VoIP gateways despite FCC STIR/SHAKEN caller ID authentication rules.

scams.name: Medicare Card / Free Brace / Genetic Kit Scam
scams.name_en: Medicare card update, back brace, or genetic testing kit scam
scams.signals_en: Unsolicited caller offers a new plastic or chip Medicare card, free back or knee brace, or DNA genetic swab kit while asking for the owner's Medicare number, Social Security number, or physician details.
scams.legit_en: CMS Medicare mails replacement cards automatically for free and never cold-calls beneficiaries to sell products or request Medicare numbers unless the beneficiary called Medicare first.
bait_tactics: Act interested in the brace or new card, pretend your wallet is upstairs, and slowly ask what colors or sizes the brace comes in
Pretend to mishear the card format and ask them to explain step by step how a chip card differs from the paper card

scams.name: IRS Back-Tax / Social Security Suspension Scam
scams.name_en: IRS back-taxes or Social Security number suspended warrant scam
scams.signals_en: Caller threatens an arrest warrant, deportation, or Social Security number suspension over unpaid taxes or alleged border crimes, demanding immediate payment via gift cards, wire transfer, prepaid debit vouchers, or a Bitcoin ATM.
scams.legit_en: The IRS and Social Security Administration initiate official tax or benefit notices by US mail, never suspend Social Security numbers, never threaten arrest by phone, and never demand gift cards, wire transfers, or crypto.
bait_tactics: Sound flustered and cooperative, and ask them to slowly spell out which tax year had the filing error while looking for reading glasses
Ask detailed questions about standard deductions and official notice letters while pretending your car keys are missing

scams.name: FTC / Federal Reserve Gold-Bar & Cash Courier Scam
scams.name_en: Government imposter instructing victim to buy gold bars or hand cash to a courier for safekeeping
scams.signals_en: Multi-stage imposter posing as bank security, FTC, FBI, or SSA OIG claims the victim's bank and retirement accounts are linked to identity theft, instructing them under strict secrecy to liquidate savings into cash or gold bars for in-person courier...
scams.legit_en: No US federal agency, inspector general, or bank ever tells citizens to withdraw cash, purchase gold bars, keep an investigation secret from family, or hand assets to a courier to 'protect' their money.
bait_tactics: Sound anxious to cooperate, say your local bank branch requires advance notice for large withdrawals, and ask how gold bar serial numbers get logged
Pretend you cannot hear clearly and ask them to repeat the Treasury locker procedure from the beginning while looking for a notepad

scams.name: Fake Missed Jury Duty Bench Warrant & Fine Scam
scams.name_en: Fake sheriff or US Marshals call threatening arrest for missed jury duty unless paid immediately
scams.signals_en: Caller spoofing a county sheriff's office or US Marshals claims the recipient missed a federal or county jury duty summons and faces immediate arrest on a bench warrant or contempt of court citation unless a bond fine is paid via prepaid voucher...
scams.legit_en: US federal and county courts handle jury summonses strictly through official mail and never phone citizens to threaten arrest or demand fines via payment apps, prepaid vouchers, gift cards, or cryptocurrency kiosks.
bait_tactics: Act surprised because you check your mailbox every afternoon, and ask which courthouse room and judge issued the summons
Say your printer is jammed and ask them to explain slowly how jury selection exemptions work in your county

scams.name: Amazon / Geek Squad Remote Support & Bank Zelle Refund Scam
scams.name_en: Fake Amazon or Geek Squad refund remote-access (AnyDesk/TeamViewer) and bank Zelle safe-account scam
scams.signals_en: Claims an unauthorized smartphone purchase or Geek Squad auto-renewal hit the account, asking the victim to install AnyDesk or TeamViewer for a 'refund' and faking an overpayment, or poses as a bank fraud desk telling the victim to Zelle money 'to...
scams.legit_en: Real retailers and bank fraud desks cancel unauthorized charges directly on their backend without remote-access tools like AnyDesk or TeamViewer and never instruct customers to send Zelle transfers to reverse a transaction.
bait_tactics: Act worried about the renewal charge, pretend your computer or banking app is stuck loading on slow Wi-Fi, and ask every detail about the item model and shipping city
Pretend you cannot find the download button and ask them to walk through how Zelle reversal works from the very beginning

scams.name: Unpaid Toll Road / E-ZPass Suspension Scam
scams.name_en: Fake E-ZPass or state toll agency threatening late penalty or registration suspension
scams.signals_en: Claims an overdue road toll balance will trigger immediate late penalties or DMV vehicle registration suspension unless paid right now via an SMS link or card over the phone.
scams.legit_en: State toll agencies mail official paper invoices and let drivers check balances by logging into their verified state toll account rather than demanding urgent phone or text-link card payments.
bait_tactics: Act puzzled because you have not driven on the turnpike in months and slowly describe two older cars in your garage to check which plate was billed
Ask which highway exit plaza recorded the toll while pretending to look for your glovebox registration slip

scams.name: Estafa de Impostores del IRS, Seguro Social y Banco (Zelle / Tarjetas de Regalo)
scams.name_en: Spanish-language IRS, Social Security, or bank arrest and account-freeze scam
scams.signals_en: Spanish-speaking caller impersonates the IRS, Social Security Administration (Seguro Social), immigration officers, or a bank fraud desk, threatening immediate arrest or account freezing unless the victim pays via gift cards, Zelle, or wire transfer.
scams.legit_en: US government agencies (IRS, SSA) and legitimate banks never threaten arrest or deportation by phone and never ask Spanish-speaking residents to pay taxes or protect accounts using gift cards, Zelle, or wire transfers.
bait_tactics: Diga con calma que la señal del teléfono se escucha entrecortada y pídale que repita despacio de qué oficina llama mientras busca sus espejuelos
Finja que la aplicación del banco está bloqueada cargando en pantalla y pregunte cómo se envía la carta oficial por correo postal
